topics.purpose: Define machine-checkable criteria required before a contract or closure set may transition from unlocked to locked.

semantics.identity_rule: Each readiness profile has an explicit identity/version.
semantics.scope_rule: Profile applies to exact contract/class/package/source-set scope.
semantics.threshold_rule: Required vs advisory criteria are explicit.
semantics.review_rule: Optional human review/approval evidence may be required explicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Readiness profile has no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority, canonical contract sources, generated projections, historical artifacts and runtime state remain separate identities/roles; no file becomes authoritative merely by name, path order, timestamp or discovery order.
Candidate canonical changes remain inert until exact format validation, identity/reference resolution, semantic diff, applicable governance/authorization and repository acceptance succeed.
